verdict.rationale: Oneleet's Fieldwork page says that after you describe a control, its AI agents collect, validate, and package evidence across your systems on your schedule. That is a first-party, user-configured background automation, but it rests on a single marketing claim with no setup docs. Built-in daily repository scans show scheduled background work but are not user-defined automations. Service keys for agent scripts are only a developer building block, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented automation configuration (triggers, schedules, actions), any general-purpose automation builder beyond evidence collection, and independent or hands-on corroboration that Fieldwork agents run autonomously.
